withdrawalWorkspace.connect.source: Connect your wallet to manage withdrawals.

withdrawalWorkspace.unavailable.source: New withdrawals are unavailable. You can still recover saved requests.
withdrawalWorkspace.unavailable.text: 新提现不可用。仍可恢复保存请求。

withdrawalWorkspace.amountInvalid.source: Enter a positive USDC amount within the limit, with at most 6 decimal places.
withdrawalWorkspace.amountInvalid.text: 输入限制内正 USDC 金额，最多 6 位小数。

withdrawalWorkspace.draftSaved.source: Unsigned draft saved. Review it before signing.
withdrawalWorkspace.draftSaved.text: 未签名草稿已保存。签名前请审阅。

withdrawalWorkspace.prepareUncertain.source: Preparation did not finish. Refresh saved requests before preparing again; a draft may already be saved.
withdrawalWorkspace.prepareUncertain.text: 准备未完成。再次准备前刷新保存请求；草稿可能已保存。

withdrawalWorkspace.networkInstruction.source: Arc Testnet · Funds go to your connected wallet.
withdrawalWorkspace.networkInstruction.text: Arc 测试网 · 资金发送到已连接钱包。

withdrawalWorkspace.prepareBoundary.source: Preparation saves an unsigned draft. Review, signing and sending are separate steps.
withdrawalWorkspace.prepareBoundary.text: 准备保存未签名草稿。审阅、签名及发送是独立步骤。

withdrawalWorkspace.separateRequest.source: Preparing another withdrawal creates a separate request. Use saved requests to resume this one.
withdrawalWorkspace.separateRequest.text: 准备另一提现会创建独立请求。使用保存请求恢复此项。

withdrawalWorkspace.preparing.text: 正在准备并保存未签名条款…

withdrawalWorkspace.limits.source: Amount limit: {amount} USDC. Maximum Circle fee: {fee} USDC, charged in addition to the amount.
withdrawalWorkspace.limits.text: 金额限制：{amount} USDC。最高 Circle 费：{fee} USDC，金额之外另收。

withdrawalReview.connect.source: Connect the original wallet to review this withdrawal.

withdrawalReview.unavailable.source: The saved original is unavailable. Keep your recovery file; do not create another request as a retry.
withdrawalReview.unavailable.text: 保存原请求不可用。保留恢复文件；不要创建另一请求重试。

withdrawalReview.signed.source: Signature saved. Review the details again before sending.
withdrawalReview.signed.text: 签名已保存。发送前再次审阅详情。

withdrawalReview.submitted.source: Submission attempt saved. Check recovery status for the original request.
withdrawalReview.submitted.text: 提交尝试已保存。检查原请求恢复状态。

withdrawalReview.uncertain.source: The operation did not finish. Your saved original is retained; use recovery to check its state.
withdrawalReview.uncertain.text: 操作未完成。保存原请求保留；使用恢复检查状态。

withdrawalReview.noExpiry.text: 无有限到期时间 · 仅恢复

withdrawalReview.signingBoundary.source: Signing saves this authorization locally. Sending is a separate step. The server checks its expiry again before transfer.
withdrawalReview.signingBoundary.text: 签名将授权保存在本地。发送为独立步骤。转账前服务器再次检查到期。

withdrawalReview.recoveryOnly.source: This request is recovery-only. Check its status in withdrawal recovery.
withdrawalReview.recoveryOnly.text: 此请求仅可恢复。在提现恢复检查状态。

withdrawalHistory.signIn.source: Sign in to view withdrawal history.

withdrawalHistory.signInAgain.source: Sign in again to view withdrawal history.
withdrawalHistory.signInAgain.text: 重新登录查看提现历史。

withdrawalHistory.loadFailed.source: History could not be loaded. Try again; your saved requests have not been changed.
withdrawalHistory.loadFailed.text: 无法加载历史。重试；保存请求未更改。

withdrawalHistory.boundary.source: Find requests saved to your account, including from another browser. These records do not confirm that funds reached your wallet.
withdrawalHistory.boundary.text: 查找保存到账户的请求，包括来自其他浏览器的请求。这些记录不确认资金已到钱包。

withdrawalHistory.empty.source: No withdrawal requests have been saved to this account.
withdrawalHistory.empty.text: 此账户未保存提现请求。

withdrawalProgress.unchecked.text: 服务器记录 · 未检查结算

withdrawalProgress.readFailed.source: Progress could not be read. This does not mean the withdrawal failed.
withdrawalProgress.readFailed.text: 无法读取进度。这不意味着提现失败。

withdrawalProgress.unavailable.source: The server could not find this request. Keep its ID and any recovery file; do not treat it as cancelled.
withdrawalProgress.unavailable.text: 服务器未找到请求。保留 ID 及恢复文件；不要视为已取消。

withdrawalProgress.signIn.source: Sign in again to check progress.

withdrawalProgress.rpcBoundary.source: Observation uses the operator's RPC; this browser has not independently verified settlement.
withdrawalProgress.rpcBoundary.text: 观察使用运营者 RPC；此浏览器未独立核验结算。

withdrawalProgress.requestSaved.source: Request saved. No transfer attempt is recorded.
withdrawalProgress.requestSaved.text: 请求已保存。未记录转账尝试。

withdrawalProgress.transferPending.source: Transfer evidence is still pending. Do not create a replacement request to retry it.
withdrawalProgress.transferPending.text: 转账证据仍待处理。不要创建替代请求来重试。

withdrawalProgress.attestationSaved.source: Transfer attestation saved. This alone does not confirm receipt in your wallet.
withdrawalProgress.attestationSaved.text: 转账证明已保存。仅此不能确认钱包到账。

withdrawalProgress.mintUnchecked.source: Mint settlement has not been checked.

withdrawalProgress.notQueued.source: No mint queue entry is reported.

withdrawalProgress.queued.source: Mint is queued; settlement is not confirmed.
withdrawalProgress.queued.text: 铸币已排队；结算未确认。

withdrawalProgress.prepared.source: Mint transaction is prepared; settlement is not confirmed.
withdrawalProgress.prepared.text: 铸币交易已准备；结算未确认。

withdrawalProgress.observedMint.source: Server reports an observed mint on {network}.
withdrawalProgress.observedMint.text: 服务器报告在 {network} 观察到铸币。

withdrawalPage.description.source: Review and recover your original USDC withdrawal requests.
withdrawalPage.description.text: 审阅并恢复原 USDC 提现请求。

withdrawalPage.introduction.source: Review your USDC withdrawal and recover the same request after a disconnect.
withdrawalPage.introduction.text: 审阅 USDC 提现，并在断线后恢复同一请求。

withdrawalPage.historyBoundary.source: {network}. Account history shows requests saved on the server, including from other browsers. Local drafts and private recovery files retain the original signing terms. Check pending requests before starting another withdrawal.
withdrawalPage.historyBoundary.text: {network}。账户历史显示服务器保存请求，包括其他浏览器请求。本地草稿及私密恢复文件保留原签名条款。开始另一提现前检查待处理请求。

withdrawalRecovery.connect.source: Connect your wallet to recover withdrawals.

withdrawalRecovery.unavailable.source: Recovery is unavailable. Keep your original request or recovery file and try checking again.
withdrawalRecovery.unavailable.text: 恢复不可用。保留原请求或恢复文件，再尝试检查。

withdrawalRecovery.imported.source: Recovery file imported. It can check the original withdrawal, but cannot send it again.
withdrawalRecovery.imported.text: 恢复文件已导入。可检查原提现，但不能再次发送。

withdrawalRecovery.privacy.source: Check a saved request or import its recovery file. Keep recovery files private: they contain a signed authorization.
withdrawalRecovery.privacy.text: 检查保存请求或导入恢复文件。请私密保管恢复文件，其中含签名授权。

withdrawalRecovery.empty.source: No withdrawal requests saved for this wallet in this browser. Import a recovery file if you have one.
withdrawalRecovery.empty.text: 此浏览器无此钱包保存提现请求。如有恢复文件可导入。

withdrawalRecovery.signIn.source: Sign in with this wallet to check the withdrawal.
withdrawalRecovery.signIn.text: 使用此钱包登录检查提现。

withdrawalRecovery.serverUnavailable.source: No server record is available. Keep the original request; this does not mean it was never submitted.
withdrawalRecovery.serverUnavailable.text: 无服务器记录。保留原请求；这不意味着从未提交。

withdrawalRecovery.unreadable.one.source: {count} saved request(s) could not be read. Other requests remain available. Keep your recovery files; unreadable records have not been deleted.
withdrawalRecovery.unreadable.one.text: 无法读取 {count} 个保存请求。其他请求仍可用。保留恢复文件；未删除不可读记录。

withdrawalRecovery.unreadable.other.source: {count} saved request(s) could not be read. Other requests remain available. Keep your recovery files; unreadable records have not been deleted.
withdrawalRecovery.unreadable.other.text: 无法读取 {count} 个保存请求。其他请求仍可用。保留恢复文件；未删除不可读记录。

withdrawalRecovery.finalized.source: Mint observed as finalized on Arc Testnet. {transactionLink}
withdrawalRecovery.finalized.text: 观察到铸币在 Arc 测试网已最终确认。{transactionLink}

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.attestation.unc.source: Transfer evidence is saved. Mint has not been checked.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.attestation.unc.text: 转账证据已保存。未检查铸币。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.attestation.not.source: Transfer evidence is saved. No mint is queued yet.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.attestation.not.text: 转账证据已保存。尚无铸币排队。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.attestation.que.source: Transfer evidence is saved. Mint is queued.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.attestation.que.text: 转账证据已保存。铸币已排队。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.attestation.pre.source: Transfer evidence is saved. Mint transaction is prepared; confirmation is not available yet.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.attestation.pre.text: 转账证据已保存。铸币交易已准备；确认尚不可用。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.transferPending.source: Waiting for transfer evidence. Mint has not been checked.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.transferPending.text: 等待转账证据。未检查铸币。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.transferPending.source: Waiting for transfer evidence. No mint is queued yet.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.transferPending.text: 等待转账证据。尚无铸币排队。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.transferPending.source: Waiting for transfer evidence. Mint is queued.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.transferPending.text: 等待转账证据。铸币已排队。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.transferPending.source: Waiting for transfer evidence. Mint transaction is prepared; confirmation is not available yet.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.transferPending.text: 等待转账证据。铸币交易已准备；确认尚不可用。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.request.uncheck.source: Request is saved. Mint has not been checked.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.request.uncheck.text: 请求已保存。未检查铸币。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.request.notQueu.source: Request is saved. No mint is queued yet.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.request.notQueu.text: 请求已保存。尚无铸币排队。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.request.queued.source: Request is saved. Mint is queued.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.request.queued.text: 请求已保存。铸币已排队。

withdrawalRecoveryStatus.request.prepare.source: Request is saved. Mint transaction is prepared; confirmation is not available yet.
withdrawalRecoveryStatus.request.prepare.text: 请求已保存。铸币交易已准备；确认尚不可用。

withdrawEarnings.signing.source: Sign the withdrawal in your wallet…

withdrawEarnings.minted.source: Minted on-chain — view the tx on ArcScan.
withdrawEarnings.minted.text: 已链上铸币，查看 ArcScan 交易。

withdrawEarnings.description.source: Citation tolls accrue to your wallet's Circle Gateway balance. Pull them on-chain into your own wallet — one signature, no gas. A small network fee is reserved from the balance.
withdrawEarnings.description.text: 引用费用累计到钱包 Circle Gateway 余额。一个签名即可提取到自己的链上钱包，无 gas。余额预留少量网络费。

withdrawEarnings.transaction.source: View the on-chain mint on ArcScan
withdrawEarnings.transaction.text: 在 ArcScan 查看链上铸币

withdrawEarnings.balanceFailed.source: Gateway balance could not be read. This does not mean your earnings are zero. {retryButton}
withdrawEarnings.balanceFailed.text: 无法读取 Gateway 余额。这不意味着收益为零。{retryButton}

creatorWithdrawal.precision.source: Enter USDC with at most six decimals
creatorWithdrawal.precision.text: 输入最多六位小数的 USDC 金额

creatorWithdrawal.signIn.source: Sign in as the original creator to continue recovery
creatorWithdrawal.signIn.text: 以原创作者身份登录以继续恢复

creatorWithdrawal.prepared.source: Unsigned original saved. Review its amount, fee and recipient before signing.
creatorWithdrawal.prepared.text: 未签名原请求已保存。签名前审阅金额、费用及接收者。

creatorWithdrawal.signed.source: Original burn signature saved; sending remains a separate step.
creatorWithdrawal.signed.text: 原销毁签名已保存；发送仍为独立步骤。

creatorWithdrawal.submitted.source: Original transfer attempt retained. Read its recovery status; do not send another burn.
creatorWithdrawal.submitted.text: 原转账尝试已保留。读取恢复状态；不要发送另一次销毁。

creatorWithdrawal.completed.text: 原所有者铸币最终性已核验

creatorWithdrawal.gasUnavailable.source: Original creator wallet and gas RPC unavailable
creatorWithdrawal.gasUnavailable.text: 原创作者钱包及 gas RPC 不可用

creatorWithdrawal.minted.source: Owner mint submitted; original finality remains pending.
creatorWithdrawal.minted.text: 所有者铸币已提交；原最终性仍待确认。

creatorWithdrawal.hashInvalid.source: Enter the original owner mint transaction hash
creatorWithdrawal.hashInvalid.text: 输入原始所有者铸造交易哈希

creatorWithdrawal.introduction.source: Arc mainnet USDC returns to your connected creator wallet. Review the Circle fee, then sign and send the original burn. Minting needs a separate owner wallet transaction and native gas.
creatorWithdrawal.introduction.text: Arc 主网 USDC 返回已连接创作者钱包。审阅 Circle 费，再签署并发送原销毁。铸币需独立所有者钱包交易及原生 gas。

creatorWithdrawal.sign.text: 签署已审阅创作者销毁

creatorWithdrawal.send.text: 发送已签名创作者销毁

creatorWithdrawal.mint.text: 审阅创作者铸币及 gas

creatorWithdrawal.complete.text: 核验创作者铸币最终性

creatorWithdrawal.recoveryBoundary.source: A lost response or interrupted wallet prompt retains the original attempt. Saved requests can be read after reload; browser data loss does not grant retry permission. Keep wallet transaction hashes for recovery.
creatorWithdrawal.recoveryBoundary.text: 丢失响应或钱包提示中断时保留原尝试。重新加载后可读取保存请求；浏览器数据丢失不授予重试许可。保留钱包交易哈希用于恢复。

creatorWithdrawal.terms.source: Amount {amount} USDC, fee at most {fee} USDC; recipient {recipient}.
creatorWithdrawal.terms.text: 金额 {amount} USDC，费用最多 {fee} USDC；接收者 {recipient}。
